messages.content: Please check the weather in Tokyo, then book flight CA1234 for Alice Chen in economy. After that, look up the Hilton Tokyo and arrange a deluxe room stay for Alice Chen from 2026-06-10 to 2026-06-14, get the stay sheet, and publish that stay sheet to user_id alice in the app with high priority. Then scan the devices in the living_room, choose the thermostat, and set it to 22°C in eco mode. Finally, set lock_main to lock and use PIN 2026 to lock it.
